lines.en: I walk lightly. The sand doesn't sound.
This path leads to the heart of my nest.
I creep along an old exit.
Sand fills my shoes.

lines.zh: 我的蚁道，一直通到沙下。
lines.en: My tunnels run deep under the sand.
My tunnel is a foot deeper.
Every step I take, the sand caves in.
That pile of sand ahead is mine.

lines.zh: 沙地下，我的巢越挖越深。
lines.en: Under the sand my nest digs deeper.
The sand runs into a slope beneath my feet.
Something below walks for me.
I've flattened the grass at the entrance.
I'm just a mound of earth; don't kick.
A worker turns over inside the nest.

lines.zh: 沙底下是我的巢，整座都是我。
lines.en: My nest is under this sand; the whole mound is me.
The sun shortens my shadow.

lines.zh: 沙一粒粒往下滑，我在下面。
lines.en: Grain by grain the sand slides; I am beneath.
Cool below, scorching above.
The wind flattens the hilltop.
This mound in the sand is all tunnels.
Under the sand, the nest stacks layer on layer.
I count what enters and leaves my entrances.
The nest under the sand runs deep.
Do not fear, this mound has never moved.
Sand trickles down the slope.

lines.zh: 楼上脚步声不是我，是沙子。
lines.en: The steps upstairs are not mine; it is sand.
I've memorized your boot size.
Under the dune, the whole nest shifts.
Your face comes close to the sand.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛一直没离开沙。
lines.en: Your eyes never leave the sand.

lines.zh: 你的影子投在我的洞口。
lines.en: Your shadow falls across my entrance.
You can't carry this hill away.
When you leave, the sand closes over.
Your boots sink half an inch.
Your breath moves the sand.
Your steps keep the sand rolling.
On the dune, I see you.
I see you, Ant Hill.
I watch you from beneath your feet.
You're standing before my dune.
You carry no shovel.
Under the sand, the whole colony stirs.

lines.zh: 我这座沙丘下面，全是通道。
lines.en: Beneath this dune, all tunnels.
You've bent down.
A new gash opens in the hill wall.
Don't kick. It's hollow beneath.
That blow takes half a layer off me.
The whole under-sand is my tunnels

lines.zh: 我只是个巢，别拿镐敲我。
lines.en: I'm only a nest; don't pick at me.
This much damage, the nest still holds.
A small piece of me collapses.
A corner of the dune is gone.
One of my tunnels collapsed.
My workers break formation.
Shake it, and I look up.
My workers gather around it first.
I'll trade you a grain of sand.

lines.zh: 这声音让我想挖深一点。
lines.en: That sound makes me want to dig deeper.
That glint in your palm is sharp.
Set it on the sand. Don't take it.
Come closer, and I'll take it.
That smell drifts to my entrance.
The whole dune is my nest.
The hill hasn't gained anything in a while.
Don't shove. The whole hill will collapse.
Sand gets into my air passages.
You're leaning on my nest wall.

lines.zh: 这座沙丘，我挖了整整一季。
lines.en: I have dug this dune a whole season.
Don't touch that sand mound; it crumbles.
Your warmth lingers on me.
You touched this ant hill of mine.
My sand pours into your boots.
That shook one tunnel loose.
You've kicked apart my hilltop.
Stay, and my workers will know you.
One collapse of sand and out we come.
I have no heart, only a nest.
The sand will cover us both.
Two hiding is safer than one.

lines.zh: 两座丘挨着，通路就短了。
lines.en: Two hills side by side shorten the road.

lines.zh: 沙地下这座丘，全是工蚁。
lines.en: Under the sand, this mound is all workers.
I'm in no hurry, and the sand will wait.
My nest is big enough for you.
Under the anthill. Follow me.
You dropped this. I'll keep it.
This pebble plugs one entrance.
I push it down to the nest floor.

lines.zh: 从沙里刨出来就是我的。
lines.en: Whatever I dig from the sand is mine.

lines.zh: 沙子下面全是我的工蚁。
lines.en: Under this sand are all my workers.

lines.zh: 沙子落进洞口，堵了一点。
lines.en: Sand slid into the entrance.
I'll keep this grain of sand too.
One hill, one colony.
Seven exits, I can count them.
One shovel and the nest under the sand caves in.
You've caved in one of my exits.
I remember your weight.
You're standing right on my nest mouth.
The workers are out; leave now.

lines.zh: 蚁丘里只有一个我，够了。
lines.en: One of me in this hill is enough.
Your foot sinks into my sand.
The whole nest shifts toward you.
I hear the sand sliding down.
You're standing on my roof
The nest under the sand is beneath your feet.
The shadow on the dune has stopped.
Now you belong to my nest.

lines.zh: 沙下有东西在数你的步。
lines.en: Something below counts your steps.

lines.zh: 沙丘一动，就是有人踩了。
lines.en: When the dune shifts, someone stepped.
I don't need to look. It's you.
I wait for you to miss a step.
That patch of sand ahead is hollow.
My workers are behind you.
Your footprints grow shallower.
My workers are crawling out.
I need not run, they will come.
I know this sand corridor better than you.
The more you run, the more holes open.

lines.zh: 你走到我背上了，还不知道。
lines.en: You are walking on my back and do not know it.
Stop, and my nest has you.
The sand sinks wherever you step.
I needn't chase. The sand will stop you.
You circle and come back to the hill.
Hold on — my ant road runs here.

lines.zh: 沙地上的脚印不会骗人。
lines.en: Footprints in the sand don't lie.
This mound is deeper than you think.
Only sandy ground is mine.
The whole nest answers to this sound.

lines.zh: 你听见地下的沙响了吗。
lines.en: Do you hear the sand shifting below?
I pull at your feet from below.

lines.zh: 你一靠近，我的工蚁就出来。
lines.en: Come close and my workers come out.

lines.zh: 你听见沙里的颚声了吗。
lines.en: Do you hear the mandibles in the sand?
Sand buries you to the waist.
Crack the hill, and the workers pour out.

lines.zh: 沙往下塌，你就陷进来了。
lines.en: The sand gives way and you sink in.
The whole sand slope collapses at you.
My workers clamp onto your boots.
Don't struggle. The more you move, the deeper you sink.
The sand gives way under you.
I heard your footfall from below.
This time, the nest gate opens.
Do not shout; the colony will hear.
You're buried to the knees.
I haul your feet downward.

lines.zh: 这里是蚁丘，不是你的路。
lines.en: This is an anthill, not your road.
You're too close to my nest mouth.
I raise this hill slowly.
My nest entrance emerges first.
The wind stops, and out I come.
I push a mound up out of the sand.
I count four exits.
Workers crawl out of the holes.

lines.zh: 沙丘底下，我的巢刚挖好。
lines.en: Beneath the dune my nest is freshly dug.

lines.zh: 我的巢口，朝着沙丘开口。
lines.en: My nest mouth opens toward the dunes.
darkness. Back again.
I push the sand open into a seam.
This stretch of sand has been empty a long while.
Whispers run beneath the sand.
A mound swells in the middle of the dune.
Someone's walking under the dune.
Who breathes inside the dune?
I wake, and the nest wakes with me.

lines.zh: 沙里的影子还没跟上我。
lines.en: My shadow in the sand hasn't caught up.
The sand is baked into hard clods.

lines.zh: 整座丘塌下来，砸得发闷。
lines.en: The whole hill caved and landed dully.
Water in the nest — everything's in chaos.
Half the dune is blown away.
An arrow sticks in my hilltop.
The spell crawls along my tunnels
The nest's stores are eaten through.
Lightning falls, and the sand fuses.
There isn't even sand here.
